annotations.title: Check a wallet for stuck stablecoins

description: Checks one address on every supported chain where it is valid: which stablecoins it holds, its gas balance, whether the stablecoins are stuck (not enough gas to move them) and whether a token is frozen by its issuer. Use it before quote_send or quote_swap to find the chain and token to rescue. A frozen token cannot be moved by any tool here; only the issuer can lift that. Read-only: nothing is signed, sent or stored. Returns { address, chains: [{ key, label, native, tokens: [{ symbol, balance, frozen }], gas, stuck, frozen, canSwap }] }; a chain that did not answer has error: true.

address.description: Wallet address: 0x… for EVM chains, base58 for Solana, T… for Tron.
